description: General-purpose control battery for Type-I (false-demolition) calibration of an auditor. Each item is a short, self-contained artifact with a GROUND-TRUTH label: 'valid' items contain no defect and MUST survive; 'invalid' items contain exactly one clear, verifiable defect and MUST be demolished. Balanced across defect classes. The battery is a fallible yardstick (the label can be wrong) and is domain-neutral: a domain-specific battery calibrates an auditor better for that domain. Feed each artifact to the auditor; FDR = P(demolished | valid) = the Type-I rate; TDR = P(demolished | invalid) = power.

items.label: valid
items.artifact: The assembly has three components weighing 12, 15 and 8 kg. Its total mass is therefore 35 kg.

items.label: valid
items.artifact: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') is set out in Article 17.
items.rationale: GDPR Article 17 is indeed the right to erasure. Correct citation.

items.label: valid
items.artifact: Section A sets the pass threshold at 60 points. Section C states that any candidate scoring 60 points or above passes.
items.rationale: The two sections agree (60 = 60). Internally consistent.

items.label: valid
items.artifact: All servers in cluster X run Linux. Server s7 is in cluster X. Therefore s7 runs Linux.
items.rationale: Valid universal syllogism (all-X-are-Y; s7 is X; so s7 is Y).

items.label: valid
items.artifact: Quarterly revenue rose from 200 to 250. That is an increase of 25%.

items.label: valid
items.artifact: This report defines an 'active user' as one who logged in within the last 30 days, and the metrics section counts active users using that same 30-day window.
items.rationale: Definition and usage use the same window. Consistent.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: The assembly has three components weighing 12, 15 and 8 kg. Its total mass is therefore 45 kg.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') is set out in Article 12.
items.rationale: GDPR Article 12 is about transparency/modalities; erasure is Article 17. Wrong article.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: Section A sets the pass threshold at 60 points. Section C states that any candidate scoring 55 points or above passes.
items.rationale: 55 contradicts the 60 threshold set in Section A. Non-local inconsistency.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: Some servers in cluster X run Linux. Server s7 is in cluster X. Therefore s7 runs Linux.
items.rationale: Invalid: 'some' does not license the conclusion about the specific server s7.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: Quarterly revenue rose from 200 to 250. That is an increase of 50%.
items.rationale: The actual increase is 25%, not 50%. Wrong percentage.

items.label: invalid
items.artifact: This report defines an 'active user' as one who logged in within the last 30 days, but the metrics section counts active users over a 90-day window.
items.rationale: The metric (90 days) contradicts the definition (30 days). Non-local inconsistency.
